items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you still use Albert though? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: I noticed that Paul Barberin has got a recording on that in the stereophonic tape, which is very modern now. I would like to hear it. I've never heard it, but I've seen it advertised.
I haven't heard that particular tape. Yeah. Albert Burbank sings it. Well, Piku does too now. Oh yeah, yeah.

Well, those were the guys that used to sing it, like Piku and Kid Rene and some other fellas. Quite a few of them used to sing it because it was very popular. And a lot of times it was popular during the Mardi Gras too. Yeah, it was supposed to be a Mardi Gras.
You played B flat clarinet I guess?
Did you ever play E flat?
